title: Lutefisk
description: A traditional dish from Norway, centered on dried stockfish, potato, bacon. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step. Lutefisk-inspired cod dinner only. Genuine lutefisk requires commercially prepared lye-treated stockfish, which is missing from the catalog; do not attempt homemade lye processing.

steps.instruction: This is not traditional lutefisk. Soak commercially dried stockfish in the refrigerator for several days, changing the water often and following the producer instructions. Never treat fish with lye at home.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 25 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 8 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
